issue_context.title: Sprite3D cannot change its scale if Billboard mode is not Disabled
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2 alpha 2

**OS/device including version:**
Win10

**Issue description:**
Billboards cannot change its size if the Billboard is Enabled or Y-Billboard
![billboard](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3036176/67385791-6cc40600-f59c-11e9-968e-283c403679cf.gif)

**Steps to reproduce:**
Create a Spite3D or AnimatedSprite3D - assign a texture, change Billboard flag, and try to change its scale.

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[BillboardBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/3761914/BillboardBug.zip)
comments: Alright @groud - I've created an issue as you requested )
